timeline.tweet: Today, I couldn't articulate all my thoughts (which isn't unusual as I am a verbal & visual processer) but I got mad at yourself out of frustration. A friend told me it is okay to be a mess. It helped to hear that. So remember: it is okay to be a mess sometimes. Remind others, too.
My constant life struggle is remembering to bring my reusable bags but always forgetting my wallet when I go to the grocery store.
After about an hour of panicking, I found it under my bed. I hope this makes you laugh as much as I laughed at myself. Have a good Tuesday.
